name: smoke_walk
text: A person walking slowly straight forward while smoking a cigarette held in the right hand. Start with the right hand low beside the hip, raise the fingertips to the lips, pause to take a puff, then lower the right hand back down beside the hip. Left arm swings gently with continuous alternating steps. Perform one complete smoking puff during the walk, no stopping.
